description: Land Acquisition - 70 and 229 allotments of lands in Kambarawa, Naula D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes descriptions of land lots, their names, types (garden, chena, paddy field, etc.), claimants, and extents. This fits perfectly within the "Land Gazettes" category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
